title: TAIFEX dataset refresh must run on the candidate stack and never block the release
hosted_verification_note: No hosted workflow was dispatched (neither nonprod-deploy.yml nor dev-tw-market-refresh.yml) and no VM or SSH access was performed. Functional and contract evidence only is recorded here; hosted verification is deferred to the next automatic dev release and operator acceptance task INSTRUMENT-EXPRESSION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.

summary.nonprod_deploy_workflow: Moved step id=taifex_market_refresh ('Refresh TAIFEX contract dataset under lease after candidate stack deploy') after step id=deploy ('Deploy dev VM stack under lease') and its candidate readiness gates while keeping TWSE refresh step id=market_refresh before stack mutation. Configured id=taifex_market_refresh and id=bounded_taifex_refresh with continue-on-error: true, --non-blocking, and normalized outcome + release evidence recording (status, reason, redacted one-shot log).
summary.dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow: Configured step id=taifex_refresh in .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml after step id=refresh (TWSE) with continue-on-error: true, --non-blocking, and normalized outcome JSON recording (status, reason, redacted one-shot log).
summary.deploy_nonprod_vm_script: Added --non-blocking flag (NON_BLOCKING_REFRESH=true), closed-session preflight priority (weekend, holiday, session_not_closed checked before dataset_missing / closed_session_missing in check_taiwan_refresh_preflight), redacted one-shot container log capture (last 200 lines), non-blocking outcome persistence (status, reason, log) for failed/skipped TAIFEX refreshes without failing the release or triggering compensation, while preserving fail-closed behaviour for TWSE refresh failures and restoring external egress to deny and source controller to reconcile_only on every path.
summary.release_manifest_validation: Allowed optional dev_verification.taifex_market_refresh object with status in {completed, noop, skipped, failed}, non-empty reason string, and log string without rejecting dev_verified release manifests.
